title: Nodes
lead: A node is the configurable unit: a signature (typed inputs → output + instructions), a model profile that executes it, bindings that resolve every input from a source, and checks on the output. Bindings are the dependencies — Dataflow draws its edges from them.

signature.title: Signature
signature.hint: typed declaration — what the node must do
signature.none: No signature — this node takes typed arguments from its bindings

profile.title: Model profile
profile.hint: who executes it — swappable, signature unchanged
profile.none: No model profile — this node runs without a model

bindings.title: Bindings
bindings.hint: each input resolved from a source — this is the dependency declaration
bindings.rewireHint: changing a binding rewires the graph: node-output sources add an edge, knowledge and state sources do not

writes.title: Writes & checks
writes.hint: what the node returns into run state, and what validates it

code.title: Generated code
code.hint: what the agent writes when you change anything above — the workflow is this file

registry.title: Registry
registry.hint: entities are reused across nodes and workflows
